title: Effects of UV-C irradiation on the physicochemical properties of freeze-dried beetroot (Beta vulgaris) powder
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00126A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Karishma Dhowtal, Che John, Rohanie Maharaj
Freeze-dried beetroot powder was treated with UV-C irradiation and the effects on quality and powder characteristics were observed. Treated powders showed higher loose and tapped bulk density, lower hygroscopicity and enhanced bioactivity.
